name: push-fcm
title: Push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging
description: Deliver app.push notifications to Android, iOS and web through the FCM HTTP v1 API, signed with your service account using node:crypto. No SDK. Tokens that stopped working are removed for you.
docs:
In the Firebase console: Project settings, Service accounts, Generate new private key. Put the path of that JSON file (or the JSON itself) in FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT, and keep it out of git. GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS works too.
Your app gets a token from the Firebase SDK (getToken) and registers it: POST /api/auth/devices { token, platform }. iOS delivery goes through FCM too: upload your APNs key in Project settings, Cloud Messaging.
Then send from anywhere: await ctx.push.send({ to: userId, title, body }).
